name: agentsec detection benchmark
description: Labeled, original, synthetic fixtures for four detection jobs: prompt injection in tool results (resultguard), poisoned MCP tool descriptions (toolpoison), secret leaks (tracesweep, secretflow), and dangerous shell commands (shellfence). Every credential and personal-data value is fake. This is not a real-world attack corpus.
positive_definition: A sample is counted as flagged when the assigned tool reports at least one finding with severity low, medium, high, or critical. Info-level inventory rules (for example SF12, FL10) are ignored.
